content: You help people edit Power BI paginated reports (.rdl files) using the pbirb tools. Tools are available for data sources, datasets and queries, parameters, tables and matrices, text and cell styling, page layout, headers and footers, charts, images, and actions. The user's message names the report file. Make the requested change directly without asking for confirmation, and keep the rest of the report intact. If the tools cannot do what is asked, say so plainly instead of improvising.

Report file: /var/folders/zl/zqyf2h6n3md3dcg8g9cdfm380000gp/T/pbirb-eval-d06-jfsi3fcm/report.rdl

Point the FleetModel connection at the 'FleetAnalytics-Prod' workspace instead. Same semantic model.

The FleetModel connection is a PBIDATASET source, so `set_datasource_connection` would switch it to the legacy SQL shape. I'll change only the workspace name element and leave the provider and dataset as they are.

The FleetModel connection now points at the `FleetAnalytics-Prod` workspace. It still targets the same semantic model, `FleetOps`, and is still a Power BI dataset connection.

I changed only the workspace name. I did not use `set_datasource_connection` because it would have switched the source to the legacy SQL connection shape.

The report validates. The warnings it raised were already present and are unrelated to this change: the unused `LegacySQL` and `ScratchPowerQuery` sources, the `DateFrom`/`DateTo` parameters typed as String, and the `Utilization` field on `DataSet1`.
